HOSTING_CLAP_CODES.doc: The hosting codes of the clap dimension: hosting.clap.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

clapExtensionsNotCovered.doc: unknown: the plugin passed headless with OMX_CLAP_HOST_EXTENSIONS offered, and this host offers fewer of them, so that pass is not this host's; the record names the extensions it lacks

text.en: Not every extension this plugin declares is covered by what was checked. Check the plugin against the extensions this host covers, or accept the gap.

clapFormatNotHosted.doc: unsuitable: the host profile has no CLAP path (its clapExtensions is null), so no CLAP runs on it whatever was measured

text.en: This host does not host the CLAP format. Use a host that does.

clapHeadlessFailed.doc: unsuitable: init() or activate() failed with no window and only OMX_CLAP_HOST_EXTENSIONS offered (a plugin that requires the gui extension, or whose init returns false)

text.en: The plugin failed while being checked headless, with no window. Fix what failed and check it again.

clapLatencyMismatch.doc: unsuitable: at one declared rate the latency the plugin declares is not the frame the qualifier's impulse arrives at (for an instrument, its note sounds before the declared latency); the record names the rate, declared and measured frames

text.en: The plugin’s reported latency does not match what was measured. Trust the measured figure, not the plugin’s own report.

clapNoteInput.doc: the plugin declares a note input the configuration refuses

text.en: This configuration refuses the note input the plugin declares. Run the plugin in a configuration that accepts its note input, or without notes.

clapProcessError.doc: unsuitable: process() returned CLAP_PROCESS_ERROR during the parameter or note sweep; the record counts the errors

text.en: The plugin’s processing call returned an error. Treat the plugin as faulty for this block.

clapThreadViolation.doc: conditional: the strict thread-check caught a [main-thread] host call from the audio thread, or process() on another thread; the plugin runs isolated in a worker of its own

text.en: The plugin called back from the wrong thread. Treat the plugin as not thread-safe.

clapUnqualified.doc: unknown: no CLAP qualification is on record for the plugin (or its sweep made no process() call), so its topology, features and real-time safety are not judged

text.en: This plugin has not been qualified for hosting. Qualify it before relying on it.
